result_text:
I fixed the four default scoping conventions that could never match, and added a regression test. The new test passes (5/5), and the full `codeanalyzer` suite passes (335 run, 0 failures, 3 skipped).

All changes are in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the path pattern is now `.*[.](html|htm|xhtml)` instead of `(html|html|xhtml)`. This is the same fix on all three rules.
- **.NET `<doc>` XML:** `.*/[.]xml` → `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- **`// Generated by …` JavaScript:** `.*/[.]js` → `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle JavaScript build scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` → `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It checks the new matches and the existing ones, such as `.html`, `.xhtml`, `build.gradle`, and a Doxygen `.html` page. It also checks that hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of the generated scope.

I did not commit anything.
